source: Part geometry: supplied MechanismKit.glb, split into its separate CAD bodies by Tools/ModelPipeline. Roles marked 'published' follow the kit description at https://www.iafsm.in/index.php?id=14&option=com_sppagebuilder&view=page. Roles marked 'geometry' were identified from shape, size and position only and need confirmation against the physical kit or manufacturer CAD.

components.name: Indexing table disc
components.summary: Round table that carries the test product from station to station.
components.function: The servo motor turns the disc in quarter-turn steps so a product placed on it stops in front of each of the four stations in turn.
components.interactions: Driven from below through the shaft coupling by the servo motor. The four stations are fixed around its rim. The test product sits in a pocket on its edge.
components.principle: Indexing: converting continuous motor rotation into accurate, repeatable stops. Here the servo drive positions the motor to a target angle (90° per station), so the controller always knows which station the product is at.
components.location: Centre of the top plate, flush with its surface.

components.name: Servo motor
components.summary: Electric motor that rotates the indexing table.
components.function: Produces the rotation that indexes the table. Its built-in encoder reports the shaft position back to the servo drive.
components.interactions: Powered and controlled by the servo drive. Bolted under the motor mount plate; its shaft drives the indexing disc through the shaft coupling.
components.principle: Closed-loop position control: the drive compares the commanded angle with the encoder feedback and corrects the motor current until the error is zero.
components.location: Hanging below the motor mount plate, directly under the indexing disc.

components.name: Servo drive
components.summary: Power electronics that command the servo motor.
components.function: Receives move commands from the PLC and supplies the motor with controlled current so the table turns to the requested station.
components.interactions: Cabled to the servo motor (power and encoder) and to the PLC trainer kit (commands and status). Mounted upright on the base plate.
components.principle: A servo drive runs the position, speed and current control loops of the motor. Connector ports on top carry the motor, encoder and communication cables.
components.location: Upright enclosure at the side of the base plate.

components.name: Shaft coupling and hub
components.summary: Connects the motor shaft to the indexing disc.
components.function: Transmits the motor torque to the disc and keeps the two shafts aligned.
components.interactions: Clamps onto the servo motor shaft below and the disc hub above.
components.principle: A coupling tolerates small misalignment between shafts while transmitting torque without backlash, which keeps the station stops accurate.
components.location: Between the servo motor and the underside of the indexing disc.

components.name: Test product with tag
components.summary: Sample workpiece that travels through the four stations.
components.function: Represents a manufactured part. It carries an RFID tag and is identified, measured, inspected and finally accepted or pushed by the solenoid.
components.interactions: Sits in a pocket on the indexing disc and moves with it. Each station acts on it when it stops in front of that station.
components.principle: Part tracking: a tag on the product lets every station associate its measurement with that specific part.
components.location: On the rim of the indexing disc, starting under the RFID head.

components.name: RFID read/write head
components.summary: Station 1 — reads and writes the product's tag.
components.function: The RFID controller reads and writes the tag values of the product as it stops at station 1.
components.interactions: Faces the product on the disc. Its data goes through the IO-Link master in the PLC trainer kit to the PLC.
components.principle: Radio-frequency identification: the head's antenna powers the passive tag by induction and exchanges data with it without contact or line of sight.
components.location: Station 1, on its bracket at the edge of the top plate, aimed at the disc rim.

components.name: RFID mounting bracket
components.summary: Holds the RFID head at the right height and distance.
components.function: Positions the RFID head so the product tag passes within its read range.
components.interactions: Screwed to the top plate; the RFID head mounts on it.
components.principle: Sensor brackets fix the working distance. RFID read range is short, so the gap between head and tag matters.
components.location: Station 1, top plate edge.

components.name: Smart distance sensor
components.summary: Station 2 — measures product height or distance.
components.function: Measures the distance to the product to verify its dimensions, and reports both the analog value and its status.
components.interactions: Mounted on an adjustable bracket above the disc rim. Communicates with the PLC through the IO-Link master.
components.principle: A distance sensor emits light and measures its reflection to compute range. IO-Link carries the measured value and diagnostics digitally to the controller.
components.location: Station 2, on the slotted L-bracket above the disc rim.

components.name: Adjustable sensor bracket
components.summary: Slotted L-bracket that sets the distance sensor height.
components.function: Holds the distance sensor; the slots and thumb screws let its height and position be adjusted.
components.interactions: Fixed to the top plate with thumb screws; carries the distance sensor.
components.principle: Slotted brackets allow fine adjustment during commissioning, then are locked in place.
components.location: Station 2, top plate.

components.name: USB vision camera
components.summary: Station 3 — inspects the product with image processing.
components.function: Captures images of the product for image processing and product testing; sorting is based on the result.
components.interactions: Hangs from the camera bridge looking down at the disc rim. Its result decides whether the solenoid acts at station 4.
components.principle: Machine vision: software compares features in the image (shape, colour, markings) with a reference to accept or reject the part.
components.location: Station 3, under the top of the camera bridge.

components.name: Camera bridge
components.summary: Arch that holds the camera above the disc.
components.function: Places the camera at a fixed height and angle above the product.
components.interactions: Bolted to the top plate; the USB camera mounts under its top.
components.principle: A rigid, repeatable camera position keeps the field of view and focus constant between parts.
components.location: Station 3, standing on the top plate over the disc rim.

components.name: Linear solenoid
components.summary: Station 4 — pushes the product when commanded.
components.function: Extends and retracts its plunger when switched by a digital output of the PLC, for example to push a rejected product.
components.interactions: Connected directly to a PLC digital output. Its plunger and pusher reach over the disc rim.
components.principle: Electromagnetic actuation: current in the coil pulls the iron plunger; a spring returns it when the current stops. The rubber bellows keeps dirt out of the plunger.
components.location: Station 4, lying on the top plate and pointing at the disc rim.

components.name: Solenoid plunger and pusher
components.summary: The moving tip that contacts the product.
components.function: Moves in a straight line out of the solenoid to push the product, then returns.
components.interactions: Driven by the solenoid; acts on the product at station 4.
components.principle: Linear motion output of the solenoid. The stroke shown in the animation is illustrative.
components.location: Station 4, at the end of the solenoid next to the disc rim.

components.name: Inductive sensor (long body)
components.summary: Cylindrical presence sensor below the disc.
components.function: Detects metal targets without contact. Its position under the disc suggests it senses the table or product position; its exact role needs confirmation.
components.interactions: Mounted vertically between the base and the top plate, aimed at the underside of the disc.
components.principle: An inductive sensor creates an alternating magnetic field; a nearby metal target absorbs energy from it and the sensor switches its output.
components.location: Under the top plate, below the disc.

components.name: Inductive sensor (M18 size)
components.summary: Second cylindrical presence sensor under the table.
components.function: Detects a metal target without contact; the kit description states each station has smart inductive sensors to sense the part's presence. Its exact target needs confirmation.
components.interactions: Mounted under the top plate near the drive train.
components.principle: Inductive proximity sensing (see the long-body sensor). M18 refers to the 18 mm threaded body.
components.location: Under the top plate, beside the servo motor.

components.name: Top plate
components.summary: Working surface that carries the disc and all four stations.
components.function: Provides a flat, rigid reference surface; the stations are fixed to it around the disc.
components.interactions: Supported by the frame legs and brackets. Has a central opening for the indexing disc.
components.principle: A common mounting plate keeps every station in a fixed relationship to the table axis.
components.location: Upper level of the machine.

components.name: Frame legs
components.summary: Four square legs that raise the top plate.
components.function: Carry the top plate above the base and leave room for the drive train underneath.
components.interactions: Stand on the base plate; joined by the cross beams; support the top plate.
components.principle: A rigid four-post frame resists twisting so the table axis stays square to the plate.
components.location: Between base plate and top plate.

components.name: Frame cross beams
components.summary: Beams that tie the legs together.
components.function: Brace the legs and provide mounting points for the drive train.
components.interactions: Bolted between the frame legs.
components.principle: Cross bracing stiffens the frame against racking.
components.location: Between the legs, under the top plate.

components.name: Top plate brackets
components.summary: Angle brackets under the top plate.
components.function: Join the top plate to the frame and drive-train supports.
components.interactions: Screwed to the underside of the top plate.
components.principle: Angle brackets transfer load between perpendicular members.
components.location: Underside of the top plate.

components.name: Motor mount plate
components.summary: Plate that carries the servo motor.
components.function: Holds the servo motor centred under the table axis.
components.interactions: Spans the frame; the servo motor is screwed to it.
components.principle: Concentric mounting keeps the motor shaft aligned with the disc axis.
components.location: Mid-level, under the disc.

components.name: Support bridge bar
components.summary: Bar spanning the frame below the disc.
components.function: Carries the disc supports and stiffens the upper frame.
components.interactions: Screwed across the frame below the top plate.
components.principle: A bridge member spreads the table loads into the frame.
components.location: Just below the top plate, across the disc axis.

components.name: Drive supports and standoffs
components.summary: Four standoff assemblies around the table axis.
components.function: Space and support the drive-train parts around the shaft.
components.interactions: Sit between the support bar and the top plate around the coupling.
components.principle: Standoffs set exact heights between parallel plates.
components.location: Around the shaft, under the disc.

components.name: Base plate
components.summary: Foundation of the kit.
components.function: Carries the frame and all electrical equipment.
components.interactions: Everything else is mounted on it; carry handles are fixed at its ends.
components.principle: A single base keeps the mechanism and its electrics together as one portable unit.
components.location: Bottom of the kit.

components.name: Carry handles
components.summary: Handles at both ends of the base.
components.function: Let the kit be lifted and carried.
components.interactions: Screwed to the ends of the base plate.
components.principle: Lift with both handles and keep the kit level.
components.location: Both short ends of the base plate.

components.name: Wiring ducts
components.summary: Slotted trunking that routes the cables.
components.function: Guides and protects the wiring between the electrical modules and the machine.
components.interactions: Run along the base between the frame and the DIN rails.
components.principle: Slotted duct keeps wiring tidy, separated and easy to trace.
components.location: On the base plate around the frame.

components.name: DIN rail (main)
components.summary: 35 mm mounting rail for the electrical modules.
components.function: Standard rail onto which the power supply, modules and terminal blocks clip.
components.interactions: Screwed to the base plate; carries the power supply, DIN modules and terminal blocks.
components.principle: Top-hat DIN rail (35 mm, EN 60715) is the industrial standard for mounting control equipment.
components.location: Along one end of the base plate.

components.name: DIN rail (short)
components.summary: Short 35 mm rail for the circuit breaker.
components.function: Mounting rail for the circuit breaker.
components.interactions: Screwed to the base plate; carries the circuit breaker.
components.principle: See DIN rail (main).
components.location: Base plate, beside the servo drive.

components.name: DIN-rail power supply
components.summary: Converts mains to the low DC voltage for sensors and controls.
components.function: Shape and position match a DIN-rail switch-mode power supply, typically 24 V DC for industrial sensors and I/O. Confirm the rating on its label.
components.interactions: Clips onto the main DIN rail; feeds the terminal blocks.
components.principle: A switch-mode supply rectifies mains and switches it at high frequency through a small transformer to give a regulated DC output.
components.location: Main DIN rail.

components.name: DIN module (large)
components.summary: Second DIN-rail module, same size class as the power supply.
components.function: Function not identifiable from the model. Check the label on the physical kit.
components.interactions: Clips onto the main DIN rail.
components.principle: DIN-rail modules share one mounting standard so they can be added or swapped easily.
components.location: Main DIN rail, end position.

components.name: DIN module (narrow)
components.summary: Narrow DIN-rail module.
components.function: Function not identifiable from the model. Check the label on the physical kit.
components.interactions: Clips onto the main DIN rail between the other modules.
components.principle: See DIN module (large).
components.location: Main DIN rail, middle position.

components.name: Terminal blocks
components.summary: Row of ten wiring terminals.
components.function: Join field wires (sensors, solenoid, motor) to the supply and control wiring in an organised, testable way.
components.interactions: Clip onto the main DIN rail next to the power supply.
components.principle: Each terminal clamps a wire with a screw or spring; colours and markers identify circuits.
components.location: Main DIN rail, end position.

components.name: Circuit breaker
components.summary: Two-pole protective switch.
components.function: Shape matches a two-pole miniature circuit breaker that protects and isolates the supply. Confirm its rating on the physical kit.
components.interactions: Clips onto the short DIN rail beside the servo drive.
components.principle: A breaker trips on overcurrent (thermal) or short circuit (magnetic) and doubles as an isolation switch.
components.location: Short DIN rail, base plate.

components.name: Top plate fasteners
components.summary: Screws and washers on the top plate.
components.function: Secure the top plate and the parts mounted on it.
components.interactions: Pass through the top plate into the frame, brackets and station mounts.
components.principle: Screw joints clamp parts together by tension in the screw. Tighten evenly in a cross pattern.
components.location: Top plate surface.

components.name: Frame fasteners
components.summary: Screws joining the frame members.
components.function: Fix the cross beams and legs together.
components.interactions: Through the cross beams into the legs.
components.principle: See top plate fasteners.
components.location: Frame joints.

components.name: Motor plate fasteners
components.summary: Screws for the motor mount plate.
components.function: Fix the motor mount plate to the frame.
components.interactions: Through the motor mount plate.
components.principle: See top plate fasteners.
components.location: Motor mount plate.

components.name: Support bar fasteners
components.summary: Screws for the support bridge bar.
components.function: Fix the support bar and drive supports.
components.interactions: Through the support bridge bar.
components.principle: See top plate fasteners.
components.location: Support bridge bar.

components.name: Servo drive fixing screw
components.summary: Screw on the servo drive mounting.
components.function: Secures the servo drive.
components.interactions: At the servo drive mounting foot.
components.principle: See top plate fasteners.
components.location: Servo drive.

stations.name: RFID station
stations.explanation: The RFID controller reads and writes the tag values of the product, and sends the data through the IO-Link master to the PLC.

stations.name: Distance sensor station
stations.explanation: The smart distance sensor measures product height or distance and reports the analog value and its status over IO-Link, verifying the product dimensions.

stations.name: Vision camera station
stations.explanation: The camera captures the product for image processing and product testing. Sorting is based on the image result.

stations.name: Solenoid station
stations.explanation: The solenoid is connected directly to a PLC digital output. The PLC program extends and retracts it, for example to push a rejected product.
